features.name: Contoso Coffee Demo Data
features.description: A fictitious company that produces coffee and coffee machines used as an initiative across Dynamics 365 products to demonstrate different features and services. Available modules include common, warehousing, manufacturing, and service.

features.name: Contoso Demo Tool
features.description: A tool that will be released in wave 2 to orchestrate configuring and running different demo data modules. Simplifies creating demo data by allowing developers to build scenario-based modules that work together and separately.
features.status_evidence_quote: the new Contoso demo tool will be available from 23.0

features.name: Demo Data Module Interface
features.description: A standardized interface that developers must implement when creating their own demo data modules. Includes procedures for customization pages, dependency specification, and creating demo data layer by layer.

features.name: Helper Code Units for Demo Data
features.description: Pre-built code units that help developers speed up the process of creating demo data by handling table population and field specification automatically. Allows reuse of existing posting groups and other master data from dependent modules.

features.name: Module Dependency System
features.description: Allows demo data modules to depend on other modules like common, warehousing, or manufacturing. Developers can reuse data created in dependent modules instead of duplicating code.

features.name: On-Demand Demo Data Creation
features.description: A future plan to move toward on-demand demo data creation instead of pre-built packages. Will eventually replace existing evaluation and extended packages.
caveats: Requires more modules to be developed first

features.name: Enhanced Company Creation Wizard
features.description: Future enhancement to the company creation wizard that will allow selecting multiple demo data modules when creating a new company, supporting pipeline automation and API-based creation.
